purpose: Attribute dense Executor worker-build latency without changing example figures or claiming a first-display improvement.

scope.operation: YardEngine worker build followed by the editor first-display update
notes: The archived baseline is the merged main revision preceding this feature.
Both observations are limited to the build/settlement path. Neither observation completed the first-display geometry/surface messages.

The initial-current observation predates the subsequent authoring corrections (closed roof, narrow twin pods, tapered ion barrels and reserved ball machinery volume). Its source hashes identify that intermediate state; it is not final-feature performance evidence.

runtime.reason: The initial current run overlapped the 28.034-second targeted model suite and craft-catalog verification. The baseline was a later bounded run.

baseline.archiveCommand: git archive e7308e2 data/reference.js data/imperial2.js data/fleet.js js/core.js js/gfx.js js/engine.js | tar -x -C /tmp/capital-baseline-runtime
baseline.lastObservedPhase: First-display geometry construction; no geometry response before the timeout.

initialCurrent.hashCapture: Source hashes captured after the initial run; Core, data and engine were frozen for this measurement.
initialCurrent.logLifetimeMethod: Filesystem log creation to last write; this is not the worker built.ms value.
initialCurrent.stopReason: Audit assertion expected legacy msl and omitted the generated podAir. The actual canonical inventory below was complete; the runtime did not report missing guns. The audit stopped before requesting first-display geometry.
initialCurrent.featureStage: Initial capital-family implementation before the later user correction to ion/TL case roles, 175TT scale and ion barrel profiles; these hashes and timings do not describe the final corrected runtime.

conclusion: The old runtime already spends 163.643 seconds building and settling this 2226-fitting Executor example, and does not finish first display inside 180 seconds. These observations establish substantial pre-existing cost, but do not quantify the final corrected feature's performance impact or establish successful Executor first display. Native ISD browser validation is recorded separately.

reproduction.notes: The checked-in harness retains the measured worker operations and canonical inventory assertions; only its repository-root default and usage comments differ from the temporary measured script. Historical command and hash fields above identify the actual observations.
